_comment: Gate 0 pre-registration precondition 3 (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md) -- the paid_gate0-mode source-pins manifest eval/score_gate0.py::SOURCE_PIN_FILES['paid_gate0'] expects. Binds the held-out-seed (1000..1004) paid mode to the SAME hash-pinned expected-pins files as readiness_dev (the 20 PIN_FIELDS pin the brain/executable/config, not the task instance -- they do not vary with mode), per-arm audit evidence LOCATIONS, and the six named metric/proof artifacts _verify_sources() reads. See eval/fixtures/gate0_expected_pins.SOURCES.md for field-by-field sourcing.
_source_frozen_seed_sha256: sha256 of eval/fixtures/gate0_miniwob_paid_seeds.json ([1000,1001,1002,1003,1004]) as committed on this branch, matching eval.score_gate0.MODES['paid_gate0'][0]. This is the hash of the LF-canonical bytes (identical to the git blob): .gitattributes pins eval/fixtures/gate0_*.json to eol=lf so every checkout on every platform materializes these exact bytes -- without that, a Windows autocrlf=true checkout would materialize CRLF and this pin would be non-portable (the same trap PR #114 fixed for host_code_sha256).
_source_artifact_paths: red_human: SAME file as readiness_dev -- Red has no dev/paid seed split (design doc:273, 'Red uses the same fixed start for agent and human'), and DAVID_BASELINES.md names only this one path for Red. miniwob_human: DELIBERATELY DIFFERENT from readiness_dev's path -- design doc:273-276 requires the paid-seed (1000..1004) human replay to happen AFTER the agent's paid attempt is banked, on the held-out seeds, never before ('DEV-seed human runs are readiness estimates, never the final denominator'); DAVID_BASELINES.md's capture_gate0_baseline_miniwob.py deliberately refuses any seed list but the DEV one, so no tool produces this file yet -- this is a known, surfaced gap (a future capture script for the paid-seed replay), not invented behavior. red_agent/miniwob_agent/wake_boundary: not yet produced (paid attempt + wake accounting are open items outside preconditions 3+4); paths mirror tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1's OutputDir convention under runs/gate0_paid/<arm>/. live_breaker: SAME real artifact as readiness_dev -- the breaker mechanism's correctness (this PR's precondition-4 deliverable) does not depend on dev-vs-paid mode.
_source_artifact_sha256: Placeholders for the five not-yet-existing artifacts are inert by construction: eval.score_gate0._verify_sources() hits FileNotFoundError reading the path before it ever compares this hash, so these strings are never actually checked. live_breaker's hash is REAL and IDENTICAL to readiness_dev's: sha256 of the actual produced runs/gate0_live_breaker/live_breaker_dry_run_trip.json (gitignored, local-only; see reports/2026-07-19-gate0-live-breaker-dry-run.md for the byte-identical committed copy + this same hash).
_source_audit_paths: Same OutputDir/launch/world layout contract as readiness_dev, under runs/gate0_paid/<arm> instead -- so a real launch with -OutputDir runs/gate0_paid/<arm> lines up with zero renaming. expected_pins point at the SAME two frozen files as readiness_dev (the 20 PIN_FIELDS pin the brain/executable/config, which this pre-reg holds constant across dev and paid mode) -- hash-pinned below via expected_pins_sha256, identical values to gate0_readiness_dev_source_pins.json.
_source_expected_pins_sha256: sha256 of eval/fixtures/gate0_expected_pins_red.json / gate0_expected_pins_miniwob.json exactly as committed on this branch -- identical to gate0_readiness_dev_source_pins.json's values, since both modes pin the same brain/executable/config. Recompute if either file is edited.
